detaileddescription.para: The selected feature is not available.

simplesect.para: MD5 and SHA-1 are considered weak message digests and their use constitutes a security risk. We recommend considering stronger message digests instead.

detaileddescription.para: Fields can be accessed with mbedtls_md_get_size and mbedtls_md_get_type.

briefdescription.para: This function returns the message-digest information associated with the given digest type.

parameterdescription.para: The type of digest to search for.

simplesect.para: The message-digest information associated with md_type.
NULL if the associated message-digest information is not found.

briefdescription.para: This function initializes a message-digest context without binding it to a particular message-digest algorithm.

detaileddescription.para: This function should always be called first. It prepares the context for mbedtls_md_setup() for binding it to a message-digest algorithm.

briefdescription.para: This function clears the internal structure of ctx and frees any embedded internal structure, but does not free ctx itself.

detaileddescription.para: If you have called mbedtls_md_setup() on ctx, you must call mbedtls_md_free() when you are no longer using the context. Calling this function if you have previously called mbedtls_md_init() and nothing else is optional. You must not call this function if you have not called mbedtls_md_init().

briefdescription.para: This function selects the message digest algorithm to use, and allocates internal structures.

detaileddescription.para: It should be called after mbedtls_md_init() or mbedtls_md_free(). Makes it necessary to call mbedtls_md_free() later.

parameterdescription.para: The information structure of the message-digest algorithm to use.
Defines if HMAC is used. 0: HMAC is not used (saves some memory), or non-zero: HMAC is used with this context.

simplesect.para: From TF-PSA-Crypto 1.0 and Mbed TLS 4.0 onwards, hmac MUST be set to 0. HMAC operations are no longer supported via MD and may only be performed via the psa_mac_ API.

briefdescription.para: This function clones the state of a message-digest context.

simplesect.para: You must call mbedtls_md_setup() on dst before calling this function.
The two contexts must have the same type, for example, both are SHA-256.
This function clones the message-digest state, not the HMAC state.
MBEDTLS_ERR_MD_FEATURE_UNAVAILABLE if both contexts are not using the same engine. This can be avoided by moving the call to psa_crypto_init() before the first call to mbedtls_md_setup().

briefdescription.para: This function extracts the message-digest size from the message-digest information structure.

parameterdescription.para: The information structure of the message-digest algorithm to use.

simplesect.para: The size of the message-digest output in Bytes.

briefdescription.para: This function gives the message-digest size associated to message-digest type.

simplesect.para: The size of the message-digest output in Bytes, or 0 if the message-digest type is not known.

briefdescription.para: This function extracts the message-digest type from the message-digest information structure.

parameterdescription.para: The information structure of the message-digest algorithm to use.

simplesect.para: The type of the message digest.

briefdescription.para: This function starts a message-digest computation.

detaileddescription.para: You must call this function after setting up the context with mbedtls_md_setup(), and before passing data with mbedtls_md_update().

briefdescription.para: This function feeds an input buffer into an ongoing message-digest computation.

detaileddescription.para: You must call mbedtls_md_starts() before calling this function. You may call this function multiple times. Afterwards, call mbedtls_md_finish().

parameterdescription.para: The buffer holding the input data.
The length of the input data.

briefdescription.para: This function finishes the digest operation, and writes the result to the output buffer.

detaileddescription.para: Call this function after a call to mbedtls_md_starts(), followed by any number of calls to mbedtls_md_update(). Afterwards, you may either clear the context with mbedtls_md_free(), or call mbedtls_md_starts() to reuse the context for another digest operation with the same algorithm.

parameterdescription.para: The buffer for the generic message-digest checksum result.

briefdescription.para: This function calculates the message-digest of a buffer, with respect to a configurable message-digest algorithm in a single call.

detaileddescription.para: The result is calculated as Output = message_digest(input buffer).

The length of the input data.
